    unique: dict[tuple[Pixel, ...], list[Pixel]] = {}
    for shape in shapes:
        normalized = normalize_shape(shape)
        unique.setdefault(tuple(normalized), normalized)
    return list(unique.values())

def _shape_matches_catalog_filters(shape: Sequence[Pixel], *, min_height: int, max_height: int | None, min_width: int, max_width: int | None, min_area: int, max_area: int | None, require_odd_extent: bool, require_inner_cell: bool) -> bool:
    """Return whether a shape satisfies catalog filters.

    Args:
      shape (Sequence[Pixel]): Shape pixels.
      min_height (int): Minimum bounding-box height.
      max_height (int | None): Maximum bounding-box height, if any.
      min_width (int): Minimum bounding-box width.
      max_width (int | None): Maximum bounding-box width, if any.
      min_area (int): Minimum number of occupied pixels.
      max_area (int | None): Maximum number of occupied pixels, if any.
      require_odd_extent (bool): Require odd height and width.
      require_inner_cell (bool): Require a hollowable inner cell.

    Returns:
      bool: Whether the shape passes the filters.
    """
    height, width = shape_size(shape)
    area = len(shape)
    if height < min_height or width < min_width:
        return False
    if max_height is not None and height > max_height:
        return False
    if max_width is not None and width > max_width:
        return False
    if area < min_area:
        return False
    if max_area is not None and area > max_area:
        return False
    if require_odd_extent and (height % 2 == 0 or width % 2 == 0):
        return False
    if require_inner_cell and (not shape_has_inner_cell(shape)):
        return False
    return True

SceneSelection = Union[SceneCell, SceneCellGroup, SceneCellPatch, SceneCount, SceneRowRun, SceneObject, tuple[SceneObject, SceneObject], SceneObjectGroup, SceneObjectReferenceGroup, SceneShapeInstance, SceneShapeInstanceGroup]

def select_shape_instances(grid: Grid, catalog_name: str='basic_countable_shapes', background_color: int=0, inference_policy: str='minimum_inference', extent_inference_policy: str='none') -> SceneShapeInstanceGroup:
    """Return semantic shape instances reconstructed from a rendered grid.

    Args:
      grid (Grid): Rendered ARC grid.
      catalog_name (str): Shape catalog used for reconstruction.
      background_color (int): Background color treated as empty space.
      inference_policy (str): Whether to minimize hidden pixels freely or
          require the reconstructed scene to contain an occlusion.
      extent_inference_policy (str): Optional geometric completion policy for
          reconstructed shapes. ``"aligned_parallel_bars"`` completes hidden
          endpoints to the shared longitudinal extent of parallel peers.

    Returns:
      SceneShapeInstanceGroup: Uniquely reconstructed semantic instances.
    """
    grid_key = tuple((tuple(row) for row in grid))
    return _cached_shape_instances(grid_key, catalog_name, background_color, inference_policy, extent_inference_policy)

def _cached_shape_instances(grid_key: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...], catalog_name: str, background_color: int, inference_policy: str, extent_inference_policy: str) -> SceneShapeInstanceGroup:
    """Return cached shape reconstruction for one immutable grid.

    Args:
      grid_key (tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]): Immutable rendered grid.
      catalog_name (str): Shape catalog used for reconstruction.
      background_color (int): Background color treated as empty space.
      inference_policy (str): Minimum-inference or required-occlusion policy.
      extent_inference_policy (str): Optional aligned-bar completion policy.

    Returns:
      SceneShapeInstanceGroup: Uniquely reconstructed semantic instances.
    """
    if inference_policy not in {'minimum_inference', 'require_occlusion'}:
        raise ValueError('shape_instances inference policy is unsupported')
    if extent_inference_policy not in {'none', 'aligned_parallel_bars'}:
        raise ValueError('shape_instances extent inference policy is unsupported')
    candidates, visible_component_count = _cached_shape_instance_candidate_data(grid_key, catalog_name, background_color)
    grid = [list(row) for row in grid_key]
    solution = _unique_best_component_cover(list(candidates), visible_component_count, require_inferred_pixel=inference_policy == 'require_occlusion')
    instances = tuple((candidate.to_instance() for candidate in solution))
    group = SceneShapeInstanceGroup(instances)
    if extent_inference_policy == 'aligned_parallel_bars':
        return infer_aligned_parallel_bar_extents(grid, group, background_color)
    return group

def _cached_shape_instance_candidate_data(grid_key: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...], catalog_name: str, background_color: int) -> tuple[tuple[_ShapeInstanceCandidate, ...], int]:
    """Return cached reconstruction candidates for one grid and catalog.

    Args:
      grid_key (tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]): Immutable rendered grid.
      catalog_name (str): Shape catalog used for reconstruction.
      background_color (int): Background color treated as empty space.

    Returns:
      tuple[tuple[_ShapeInstanceCandidate, ...], int]: Candidate instances and
      visible component count.
    """
    grid = [list(row) for row in grid_key]
    visible_components = _visible_components(grid, background_color)
    if not visible_components:
        raise ValueError('shape_instances selector requires visible pixels')
    component_pixels = [frozenset(component.pixels) for component in visible_components]
    component_by_pixel = _component_index_by_pixel(visible_components)
    candidates = tuple(_shape_instance_candidates(grid, shape_instance_catalog(catalog_name), component_pixels, component_by_pixel, background_color))
    return (candidates, len(visible_components))

def _visible_components(grid: Grid, background_color: int) -> list[Component]:
    """Return orthogonal same-color components outside one background color.

    Unlike the general ARC component helper, this selector permits color zero
    to be foreground when another color is explicitly configured as the
    background.

    Args:
      grid (Grid): Rendered ARC grid.
      background_color (int): Color excluded from visible components.

    Returns:
      list[Component]: Visible components in row-major discovery order.
    """
    height, width = (len(grid), len(grid[0]))
    seen: set[Pixel] = set()
    visible_components: list[Component] = []
    for row in range(height):
        for col in range(width):
            color = grid[row][col]
            if color == background_color or (row, col) in seen:
                continue
            queue = [(row, col)]
            seen.add((row, col))
            pixels: list[Pixel] = []
            while queue:
                pixel = queue.pop()
                pixels.append(pixel)
                for neighbor in neighbors4(pixel, height, width):
                    if neighbor in seen:
                        continue
                    if grid[neighbor[0]][neighbor[1]] != color:
                        continue
                    seen.add(neighbor)
                    queue.append(neighbor)
            visible_components.append(Component(color, pixels))
    return visible_components

def infer_aligned_parallel_bar_extents(grid: Grid, group: SceneShapeInstanceGroup, background_color: int=0) -> SceneShapeInstanceGroup:
    """Complete bar endpoints hidden at a parallel group's shared boundary.

    Only non-background cells contiguous with an existing endpoint are added.
    The completion therefore recovers endpoints covered by perpendicular bars
    without extending a bar through empty space.

    Args:
      grid (Grid): Rendered grid containing reconstructed shape instances.
      group (SceneShapeInstanceGroup): Reconstructed bar-shaped instances.
      background_color (int): Color treated as empty space.

    Returns:
      SceneShapeInstanceGroup: Instances with aligned hidden endpoints added.
    """
    grouped_indices: dict[tuple[int, str], list[int]] = {}
    for index, instance in enumerate(group.instances):
        orientation = shape_instance_orientation(instance)
        if orientation is not None:
            grouped_indices.setdefault((instance.color, orientation), []).append(index)
    inferred_by_index = [set(instance.inferred_pixels) for instance in group.instances]
    for (_, orientation), indices in grouped_indices.items():
        if len(indices) < 2:
            continue
        instance_bounds = [bounds(group.instances[index].visible_pixels + group.instances[index].inferred_pixels) for index in indices]
        if orientation == 'vertical':
            shared_minimum = min((min_row for min_row, _, _, _ in instance_bounds))
            shared_maximum = max((max_row for _, _, max_row, _ in instance_bounds))
        else:
            shared_minimum = min((min_col for _, min_col, _, _ in instance_bounds))
            shared_maximum = max((max_col for _, _, _, max_col in instance_bounds))
        for index, (min_row, min_col, max_row, max_col) in zip(indices, instance_bounds):
            if orientation == 'vertical':
                endpoint_bands = (range(min_row - 1, shared_minimum - 1, -1), range(max_row + 1, shared_maximum + 1))
                for rows in endpoint_bands:
                    for row in rows:
                        cells = {(row, col) for col in range(min_col, max_col + 1)}
                        if any((grid[cell_row][cell_col] == background_color for cell_row, cell_col in cells)):
                            break
                        inferred_by_index[index].update(cells)
            else:
                endpoint_bands = (range(min_col - 1, shared_minimum - 1, -1), range(max_col + 1, shared_maximum + 1))
                for cols in endpoint_bands:
                    for col in cols:
                        cells = {(row, col) for row in range(min_row, max_row + 1)}
                        if any((grid[cell_row][cell_col] == background_color for cell_row, cell_col in cells)):
                            break
                        inferred_by_index[index].update(cells)
    completed_instances: list[SceneShapeInstance] = []
    for instance, inferred_pixels in zip(group.instances, inferred_by_index):
        full_pixels = set(instance.visible_pixels) | inferred_pixels
        completed_instances.append(SceneShapeInstance(color=instance.color, visible_pixels=instance.visible_pixels, inferred_pixels=tuple(sorted(inferred_pixels)), full_shape_pixels=tuple(normalize_shape(list(full_pixels)))))
    return SceneShapeInstanceGroup(tuple(completed_instances))

def shape_instance_order_key(instance: SceneShapeInstance) -> tuple[object, ...]:
    """Return a stable ordering key for one reconstructed shape instance.

    Args:
      instance (SceneShapeInstance): Shape instance to order.

    Returns:
      tuple[object, ...]: Stable geometry and color key.
    """
    pixels = instance.visible_pixels + instance.inferred_pixels
    return (min(pixels), max(pixels), instance.color, pixels)

def shape_instance_orientation(instance: SceneShapeInstance) -> str | None:
    """Return a semantic shape instance's non-square extent orientation.

    Args:
      instance (SceneShapeInstance): Semantic shape instance to inspect.

    Returns:
      str | None: Horizontal, vertical, or ``None`` for a square extent.
    """
    min_row, min_col, max_row, max_col = bounds(instance.visible_pixels + instance.inferred_pixels)
    height = max_row - min_row + 1
    width = max_col - min_col + 1
    if width > height:
        return 'horizontal'
    if height > width:
        return 'vertical'
    return None

def shape_instance_catalog(catalog_name: str='basic_countable_shapes') -> tuple[tuple[Pixel, ...], ...]:
    """Return normalized shape templates for semantic instance inference.

    Args:
      catalog_name (str): Name of the shape catalog.

    Returns:
      tuple[tuple[Pixel, ...], ...]: Normalized shape templates.
    """
    if catalog_name == 'filled_rectangles':
        return tuple((tuple(filled_rect_pixels(width, height)) for height in range(1, 31) for width in range(1, 31) if height * width >= 3))
    if catalog_name == 'solid_layer_shapes':
        return _solid_layer_shapes()
    if catalog_name != 'basic_countable_shapes':
        raise ValueError('Unknown shape-instance catalog: ' + catalog_name)
    shapes: list[list[Pixel]] = []
    shapes.extend(_rectangle_shapes(max_extent=7))
    shapes.extend(_diagonal_shapes(max_length=7))
    shapes.extend((filled_diamond_pixels(size) for size in (3, 5, 7)))
    shapes.extend(object_shape_catalog(min_area=3, max_height=7, max_width=7))
    return tuple((tuple(shape) for shape in _dedupe_shapes(shapes)))

def _solid_layer_shapes() -> tuple[tuple[Pixel, ...], ...]:
    """Return dense hole-free silhouettes for clear layered scenes.

    Returns:
      tuple[tuple[Pixel, ...], ...]: Filled rectangles, triangles, and diamonds.
    """
    shapes = [filled_rect_pixels(width, height) for height in range(2, 8) for width in range(2, 8)]
    shapes.extend(_right_triangle_shapes(max_extent=7))
    shapes.extend((filled_diamond_pixels(size) for size in (3, 5, 7)))
    return tuple((tuple(shape) for shape in _dedupe_shapes(shapes)))

def _right_triangle_shapes(max_extent: int) -> list[list[Pixel]]:
    """Return filled right triangles in all four orientations.

    Args:
      max_extent (int): Maximum equal height and width.

    Returns:
      list[list[Pixel]]: Normalized triangle templates.
    """
    shapes: list[list[Pixel]] = []
    for extent in range(2, max_extent + 1):
        triangle = [(row, col) for row in range(extent) for col in range(extent - row)]
        for _ in range(4):
            shapes.append(normalize_shape(triangle))
            triangle = normalize_shape([(col, -row) for row, col in triangle])
    return shapes

def _rectangle_shapes(max_extent: int) -> list[list[Pixel]]:
    """Return countable filled and hollow rectangle templates.

    Args:
      max_extent (int): Maximum rectangle height or width.

    Returns:
      list[list[Pixel]]: Rectangle templates.
    """
    shapes: list[list[Pixel]] = []
    for height in range(1, max_extent + 1):
        for width in range(1, max_extent + 1):
            area = height * width
            if area >= 3 and (height == 1 or width == 1 or area >= 4):
                shapes.append(filled_rect_pixels(width, height))
            if height >= 3 and width >= 3:
                shapes.append(hollow_rect_pixels(width, height))
    return shapes

def _diagonal_shapes(max_length: int) -> list[list[Pixel]]:
    """Return diagonal line and diagonal-band templates.

    Args:
      max_length (int): Maximum diagonal extent.

    Returns:
      list[list[Pixel]]: Diagonal templates.
    """
    shapes = _single_pixel_diagonal_shapes(max_length)
    for length in range(3, max_length + 1):
        shapes.append([pixel for idx in range(length - 1) for pixel in ((idx, idx), (idx + 1, idx))])
        shapes.append([pixel for idx in range(length - 1) for pixel in ((idx, length - 2 - idx), (idx + 1, length - 2 - idx))])
    return shapes

def _single_pixel_diagonal_shapes(max_length: int) -> list[list[Pixel]]:
    """Return one-cell-thick diagonal line templates.

    Args:
      max_length (int): Maximum diagonal extent.

    Returns:
      list[list[Pixel]]: Rising and falling diagonal lines.
    """
    shapes: list[list[Pixel]] = []
    for length in range(3, max_length + 1):
        shapes.append([(idx, idx) for idx in range(length)])
        shapes.append([(idx, length - 1 - idx) for idx in range(length)])
    return shapes

def _component_index_by_pixel(visible_components: list[Component]) -> dict[Pixel, int]:
    """Return a pixel-to-component index map.

    Args:
      visible_components (list[Component]): Visible same-color components.

    Returns:
      dict[Pixel, int]: Component index for every visible pixel.
    """
    component_by_pixel: dict[Pixel, int] = {}
    for idx, component in enumerate(visible_components):
        for pixel in component.pixels:
            component_by_pixel[pixel] = idx
    return component_by_pixel

def _shape_instance_candidates(grid: Grid, catalog: tuple[tuple[Pixel, ...], ...], component_pixels: list[frozenset[Pixel]], component_by_pixel: dict[Pixel, int], background_color: int) -> list[_ShapeInstanceCandidate]:
    """Return all valid shape-instance candidates for a grid.

    Args:
      grid (Grid): Rendered ARC grid.
      catalog (tuple[tuple[Pixel, ...], ...]): Shape templates.
      component_pixels (list[frozenset[Pixel]]): Pixels for each visible
          component.
      component_by_pixel (dict[Pixel, int]): Component index by visible pixel.
      background_color (int): Background color treated as empty space.

    Returns:
      list[_ShapeInstanceCandidate]: Valid candidates.
    """
    height, width = (len(grid), len(grid[0]))
    background_prefix = _background_prefix_sums(grid, background_color)
    unique: dict[tuple[int, tuple[Pixel, ...], tuple[Pixel, ...], tuple[Pixel, ...]], _ShapeInstanceCandidate] = {}
    for shape in catalog:
        shape_height, shape_width = shape_size(shape)
        if shape_height > height or shape_width > width:
            continue
        is_filled_rectangle = len(shape) == shape_height * shape_width
        for row in range(height - shape_height + 1):
            for col in range(width - shape_width + 1):
                if is_filled_rectangle and _rectangle_sum(background_prefix, row, col, shape_height, shape_width):
                    continue
                absolute_pixels = tuple(sorted(((shape_row + row, shape_col + col) for shape_row, shape_col in shape)))
                placement_colors = {grid[pixel_row][pixel_col] for pixel_row, pixel_col in absolute_pixels}
                if background_color in placement_colors:
                    continue
                for color in sorted(placement_colors):
                    candidate = _candidate_for_placement(grid, shape, absolute_pixels, color, component_pixels, component_by_pixel, background_color)
                    if candidate is None:
                        continue
                    key = (candidate.color, tuple(sorted(candidate.visible_pixels)), tuple(sorted(candidate.inferred_pixels)), candidate.full_shape_pixels)
                    unique.setdefault(key, candidate)
    return list(unique.values())

def _background_prefix_sums(grid: Grid, background_color: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Return summed-area counts of background cells.

    Args:
      grid (Grid): Rendered ARC grid.
      background_color (int): Color counted as background.

    Returns:
      list[list[int]]: Prefix matrix with one leading row and column.
    """
    height, width = (len(grid), len(grid[0]))
    prefix = [[0] * (width + 1) for _ in range(height + 1)]
    for row in range(height):
        row_total = 0
        for col in range(width):
            row_total += int(grid[row][col] == background_color)
            prefix[row + 1][col + 1] = prefix[row][col + 1] + row_total
    return prefix

def _rectangle_sum(prefix: list[list[int]], row: int, col: int, height: int, width: int) -> int:
    """Return a rectangle sum from a leading-edge prefix matrix.

    Args:
      prefix (list[list[int]]): Summed-area matrix.
      row (int): Rectangle top row.
      col (int): Rectangle left column.
      height (int): Rectangle height.
      width (int): Rectangle width.

    Returns:
      int: Sum over the requested rectangle.
    """
    bottom = row + height
    right = col + width
    return prefix[bottom][right] - prefix[row][right] - prefix[bottom][col] + prefix[row][col]

def _candidate_for_placement(grid: Grid, shape: tuple[Pixel, ...], absolute_pixels: tuple[Pixel, ...], color: int, component_pixels: list[frozenset[Pixel]], component_by_pixel: dict[Pixel, int], background_color: int) -> _ShapeInstanceCandidate | None:
    """Return one valid candidate for a shape placement, if any.

    Args:
      grid (Grid): Rendered ARC grid.
      shape (tuple[Pixel, ...]): Normalized shape template.
      absolute_pixels (tuple[Pixel, ...]): Shape pixels at a grid position.
      color (int): Candidate object color.
      component_pixels (list[frozenset[Pixel]]): Pixels for each visible
          component.
      component_by_pixel (dict[Pixel, int]): Component index by visible pixel.
      background_color (int): Background color treated as empty space.

    Returns:
      _ShapeInstanceCandidate | None: Candidate when the placement is valid.
    """
    visible_pixels: set[Pixel] = set()
    inferred_pixels: set[Pixel] = set()
    component_indices: set[int] = set()
    for row, col in absolute_pixels:
        value = grid[row][col]
        if value == background_color:
            return None
        if value == color:
            pixel = (row, col)
            visible_pixels.add(pixel)
            component_indices.add(component_by_pixel[pixel])
        else:
            inferred_pixels.add((row, col))
    if not visible_pixels:
        return None
    component_support = frozenset((pixel for idx in component_indices for pixel in component_pixels[idx]))
    if component_support != frozenset(visible_pixels):
        return None
    return _ShapeInstanceCandidate(color=color, visible_pixels=frozenset(visible_pixels), inferred_pixels=frozenset(inferred_pixels), full_shape_pixels=tuple(shape), component_indices=frozenset(component_indices))

def _unique_best_component_cover(candidates: list[_ShapeInstanceCandidate], component_count: int, require_inferred_pixel: bool=False) -> tuple[_ShapeInstanceCandidate, ...]:
    """Return a unique best exact cover of visible components.

    Args:
      candidates (list[_ShapeInstanceCandidate]): Valid shape candidates.
      component_count (int): Number of visible components to cover.
      require_inferred_pixel (bool): Whether at least one selected instance
          must contain a pixel hidden behind another shape.

    Returns:
      tuple[_ShapeInstanceCandidate, ...]: Unique best candidate cover.
    """
    target = frozenset(range(component_count))
    candidates_by_component: dict[int, list[_ShapeInstanceCandidate]] = {idx: [] for idx in target}
    max_components_per_candidate = 1
    for candidate in candidates:
        max_components_per_candidate = max(max_components_per_candidate, len(candidate.component_indices))
        for idx in candidate.component_indices:
            candidates_by_component[idx].append(candidate)
    for idx, component_candidates in candidates_by_component.items():
        if not component_candidates:
            raise ValueError('shape_instances could not explain component ' + str(idx))
        component_candidates.sort(key=_candidate_sort_key)
    best_cost: tuple[int, ...] | None = None
    best_solutions: list[tuple[_ShapeInstanceCandidate, ...]] = []

    def search(uncovered: frozenset[int], solution: tuple[_ShapeInstanceCandidate, ...], inferred_count: int) -> None:
        nonlocal best_cost, best_solutions
        if best_cost is not None:
            lower_bound = len(solution) + ceil(len(uncovered) / max_components_per_candidate)
            if lower_bound > best_cost[0]:
                return
        if not uncovered:
            if require_inferred_pixel and inferred_count == 0:
                return
            cost: tuple[int, ...] = (len(solution), inferred_count)
            if require_inferred_pixel:
                inferred_visible_support = sum((len(candidate.visible_pixels) for candidate in solution if candidate.inferred_pixels))
                cost += (-inferred_visible_support,)
            if best_cost is None or cost < best_cost:
                best_cost = cost
                best_solutions = [solution]
            elif cost == best_cost:
                best_solutions.append(solution)
            return
        first_idx = min(uncovered)
        for candidate in candidates_by_component[first_idx]:
            if not candidate.component_indices.issubset(uncovered):
                continue
            next_inferred_count = inferred_count + len(candidate.inferred_pixels)
            if best_cost is not None and (len(solution) + 1, next_inferred_count) > best_cost[:2]:
                continue
            search(uncovered - candidate.component_indices, solution + (candidate,), next_inferred_count)
    search(target, (), 0)
    if not best_solutions:
        raise ValueError('shape_instances found no complete component cover')
    canonical_solutions = {_solution_key(solution): solution for solution in best_solutions}
    if len(canonical_solutions) != 1:
        raise ValueError('shape_instances found ambiguous shape decompositions')
    return tuple(sorted(next(iter(canonical_solutions.values())), key=_candidate_sort_key))

def _candidate_sort_key(candidate: _ShapeInstanceCandidate) -> tuple[object, ...]:
    """Return a stable ordering key for shape-instance candidates.

    Args:
      candidate (_ShapeInstanceCandidate): Candidate to sort.

    Returns:
      tuple[object, ...]: Stable sort key.
    """
    min_row = min((row for row, _ in candidate.visible_pixels))
    min_col = min((col for _, col in candidate.visible_pixels))
    return (candidate.color, min_row, min_col, len(candidate.inferred_pixels), len(candidate.visible_pixels), tuple(sorted(candidate.visible_pixels)), tuple(sorted(candidate.inferred_pixels)), candidate.full_shape_pixels)

def _solution_key(solution: tuple[_ShapeInstanceCandidate, ...]) -> tuple[tuple[object, ...], ...]:
    """Return a canonical signature for a candidate-cover solution.

    Args:
      solution (tuple[_ShapeInstanceCandidate, ...]): Cover solution.

    Returns:
      tuple[tuple[object, ...], ...]: Canonical solution signature.
    """
    return tuple((_candidate_sort_key(candidate) for candidate in sorted(solution, key=_candidate_sort_key)))

def reorder_shape_layers(grid: Grid, group: SceneShapeInstanceGroup, action: dict[str, Any]) -> Grid:
    """Re-render reconstructed shapes in a requested back-to-front order.

    Args:
      grid (Grid): Rendered input grid.
      group (SceneShapeInstanceGroup): Full semantic shape instances.
      action (dict[str, Any]): Layer-order expression. Supported orders are
          ``reverse`` and area- or orientation-based ``sort``.

    Returns:
      Grid: Same-sized grid with the selected z-order applied.
    """
    instances = group.instances
    if len(instances) < 2:
        raise ValueError('reorder_shape_layers requires at least two instances')
    order_expression = action.get('order')
    if not isinstance(order_expression, dict):
        raise ValueError('reorder_shape_layers requires an order expression')
    order_op = order_expression.get('op')
    if order_op == 'sort':
        sort_key = order_expression.get('key')
        if sort_key == {'op': 'shape_area'}:
            direction = order_expression.get('direction')
            if direction not in {'ascending', 'descending'}:
                raise ValueError('reorder_shape_layers sort direction is unsupported')
            render_order = sorted(range(len(instances)), key=lambda index: (instances[index].area, shape_instance_order_key(instances[index])), reverse=direction == 'descending')
        elif sort_key == {'op': 'shape_orientation'}:
            value_order = order_expression.get('value_order')
            if not isinstance(value_order, list) or len(value_order) != 2 or set(value_order) != {'horizontal', 'vertical'}:
                raise ValueError('reorder_shape_layers orientation value_order is unsupported')
            rank = {value: index for index, value in enumerate(value_order)}
            orientations = [shape_instance_orientation(instance) for instance in instances]
            if any((orientation not in rank for orientation in orientations)):
                raise ValueError('reorder_shape_layers orientation sort requires non-square shapes')
            render_order = sorted(range(len(instances)), key=lambda index: (rank[str(orientations[index])], shape_instance_order_key(instances[index])))
        else:
            raise ValueError('reorder_shape_layers sort key is unsupported')
    else:
